newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc up, but other base metals ranged.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc up, but other base metals ranged.

text.p: Zinc prices moved up on the local market on Friday but other base metals were steady in a narrow trading range, dealers said.

Zinc prices rose by 50 rupees at 8,100 rupees per quintal as an uptrend in the world market and limited offerings by local producers helped prices bounce back while physical demand was at a low ebb. Copper was steady at 13,750 rupees per quintal after gaining 50 rupees on Thursday.
Tin was steady at the improved level of 31,400 rupees as was nickel at 36,500 rupees per quintal amid limited inflow while offerings were slow following reports of rising world prices.
On Thursday tin was up 200 rupees and nickel was up 100 rupees per quintal. Lead was quiet at 4,100 rupees as was aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal amid limited activity.
Overall market sentiment was steady at the close and volume was low.
